description: Three people swim above a face formed in a rooftop swimming pool at sunset, beside a fish-shaped shadow.
An older lift operator stands in a brass lift suspended between pear-covered vines in a vast cave, with a white dog on a ledge nearby.
Two beachcombers stand on an enormous red knitted glove whose fingertips pour golden sand into waves on a rocky shore.
A woman in a yellow tracksuit runs past washing machines containing planets as leaves spill from one and a blue sock floats above a stool.
Two climbers grasp a giant blue zipper joining pink cliffs, with stars and a cactus visible through its open section.
People with flower-filled shadows queue at an ice cream cart on a lunar plain, where a vendor offers a cone containing a rain cloud.
A runner ties a shoe on a red running track carried by a giant tortoise through a misty marsh, with a white ribbon trailing into the water.
A woman with a silver prosthetic forearm folds a snowy mountain range on a worktable as a river flows from it into a teacup.
Two older people share popcorn in a balcony overlooking an underwater cinema where fish circle before the screen and a diver accompanies a seahorse.
A cyclist rides along the curling peel of a giant orange above a white seaside town as orange-segment sailboats float through the sky.
A boy waters transparent chairs containing flowers and roots in a moonlit greenhouse, with a red bird inside the nearest chair.
A lighthouse made from stacked teacups shines over a stormy sea as a boat with a spoon mast approaches its rocky base.
A child holds a giraffe-shaped shadow at a market stall beneath an enormous suspended jade chess knight.
An orange-suited traveller carries a mirror showing a tropical forest across snow, with a parrot on its frame and red petals in the footprints.
An animal marching band passes a giant open sardine tin containing tiny beds and sleeping figures in a yellow meadow.
An older woman plays a cello whose strings stretch towards waterfalls in a dry terracotta reservoir, beside a crab carrying a white flower.
Two people face each other across a giant sewing needle bridging rooftops, with coral thread wrapped around a sleeping crescent moon below.
A giant cut apple contains furnished rooms in a misty harbour while a tugboat tows a red leaf past a woman holding a bitten apple.
Three masked dancers stand on a floating drum encircled by cloud rings above rice terraces, while a farmer holds a ladder below.
A giant yellow moth rests across an airport luggage belt carrying suitcases with small bare trees, while a cleaner examines a glowing fallen scale.
A woman climbs a ladder to lift a vast red curtain in a desert, revealing a vertical sea and sailboat whose shadow falls on the sand.
A child and an older man play with dominoes containing doorways on a giant lily pad, while a heron peers into one above square ripples.
Workers drink tea beneath a giant glass trumpet containing red trees, with a brass pipe curling into a sleeping cat shape.
